title: ELPAC: Endpoint-Anchored Latent Progression with Stage-Varying Multimodal Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2611.08541v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aging cohorts increasingly combine imaging, plasma, and cognitive measurements, but most subjects provide only a partially observed cross-sectional snapshot, leaving latent stage, progression subtype, and stage-varying multimodal coordination to be inferred jointly. Existing methods estimate the cohort-level aging process, model covariance under observed covariates, or fuse modalities for prediction. However, they rarely target the joint problem of endpoint-anchored staging and progression-resolved residual coordination across modalities, even though subject staging, subtype assignment, and multimodal interplay are mutually dependent. We introduce ELPAC, a Bayesian framework with two interlocking constructions. The first integrates subtype trajectories backward from clinically reliable endpoint groups along biologically structured velocity components encoding modality-specific monotone direction and optional sequential ordering priors. translated_title: ELPAC：端点锚定的潜在进展与阶段变化的多模态协调
translated_abstract: 老年队列研究日益结合影像、血浆和认知测量数据，但大多数受试者仅提供了部分观测的横断面快照，使得潜在阶段、进展亚型以及随阶段变化的多模态协调需要被联合推断。现有方法主要估计队列层面的衰老过程、在观测协变量下建模协方差，或融合多模态进行预测。然而，尽管受试者分期、亚型分配和多模态相互作用彼此相互依赖，这些方法很少针对端点锚定分期与按进展解析的跨模态残差协调这一联合问题。我们提出了ELPAC，一个包含两个相互衔接构造的贝叶斯框架。第一个构造从临床可靠的终点组出发，沿着编码模态特异性单调方向及可选顺序排列先验的生物学结构化速度分量，反向整合亚型轨迹。
tldr: 提出ELPAC贝叶斯框架，通过端点锚定的潜在进展建模与阶段变化的多模态残差协调，从部分观测的横断面数据中联合推断老年队列受试者的潜在阶段、进展亚型及跨模态相互作用。
en_tdlr: ELPAC is a Bayesian framework that jointly infers latent staging, progression subtypes, and stage-varying multimodal coordination from partially observed cross-sectional aging data, using endpoint-anchored latent progression and progression-resolved residual coordination across modalities.
